subject: Request: temporary rate bridge + traffic snapshot for BrightPath launch
messages:
From: Nora Chan <nora.chan@brightpath.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightPath launch spike — temporary throughput ask

Hi Rishi,

Quick heads up: BrightPath is going live with their conversational assistant on Monday 1/18 and we expect a warmup -> initial surge window on 1/18–1/20. Engineering has given us a conservative projection of 3.2M token requests/day (peaks ~7M tokens/day in 6–8 hour window) during the first 48 hours due to onboarding flows.

Can Redwood provide a temporary rate uplift (short-term bridge) for the first 72 hours and a short-term quota bump for their pilot? We care about:
- Sustained per-second request rate (we typically see many short chats rather than long generations)
- Burst tolerance for a 6-hour kickoff window
- Clear rollback/fallback if we hit behavioral anomalies

I attached a CSV with the traffic snapshot and annotated ramp. Our security team will also need confirmation that logs and audit retention remain the same.

Thanks — Nora
Nora Chan
Head of Platform
BrightPath AI

Attachment: brightpath_launch_traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc:
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightPath launch spike — temporary throughput ask

Team — forwarding BrightPath's request. TL;DR: pilot launch 1/18, expect concentrated token bursts (short chats), projection attached. They want a 72-hour temporary uplift + a short-term rate carveout during the kickoff.

What I need from you:
1) Product: can we support a short-lived rate bridge policy that applies only to this customer (route-level carveout + automatic rollback)? Any product/security asks we should surface?
2) Infra/Capacity (Priyom/David): feasibility on a dedicated temporary entitlement, potential impact to autoscaler and headroom, and an operational rollback playbook.
3) Sales/CS (Marissa): confirmation on SLA/credits language and whether we need a signed commitment for the uplift.

Attachments: brightpath_launch_traffic_snapshot.csv (from customer)

I want to align on a recommended plan by EOD Thursday (1/14) so we can confirm before their warmup.

—Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightPath launch spike — temporary throughput ask

Rishi — thanks for the flag. A few quick product / commercial questions before we sign off:

- Duration: customer asked 72 hours. Would product prefer a 96-hour window to give us padding for rollback?
- Scope: do we want to do route-level carveout (only their /generate endpoints) or broader quota bump? Route-level is safer but may be operationally heavier.
- Metric gating: we should tie the uplift to explicit health gates (latency p95, GPU error-rate, token-cost deltas). If any gate trips, automatic revert to baseline.
- Credits: is this something we give as free uplift or do we bill (and then refund/credit if we fail to meet guardrails)?

Also need a small ask for the roadmap: To support more of these short-lived customer carveouts we should add a "temporary entitlement" mode in the Console (select customer, start/end, health gates, auto-revert). That feature likely takes a small effort but will avoid manual config during business hours.

Can Priyom/David comment on technical feasibility and estimated time to stand up a manual carveout for 1/18?

—Marissa
Product (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightPath launch spike — temporary throughput ask

Looping infra ops notes / plan. Quick summary: manual short-lived entitlement is feasible but operationally intensive; recommended steps below for the 1/18 kickoff.

Operational proposal (manual carveout):
- Provision a customer-scoped rate bridge: increase per-customer concurrency from 150 -> 600 and token-per-minute ceiling increased by 4x for 72 hours. Scope to their project id only.
- Autoscaler guard: pre-warm an additional small pool of spare GPUs in the same region (us-west-2) to absorb the 6-hour kickoff window. Forecasted extra capacity: 2 A100 nodes (estimated).
- Health gates (automated): latency p95 > 1.2s OR GPU OOMs > 0.5% in any 15m window -> automatic revert.
- Fallback: if gate trips, redirect BrightPath to a compatible quantized model tier with lower token cost and inform the customer via CS.
- Rollback & monitoring: run a dedicated dashboard with token-level charts and a pager for infra on the first two launch days.

Estimated ops time to implement manual carveout: 6–8 hours (I can own/run it with 2 engineers on-call during the kickoff). Pre-warm cost for the 48h window: estimate $Xk (exact numbers in drive link).

Technical asks for product: a simple API key-level override point (allow routing policy to accept a temporary entitlement & a TTL). If product cannot expose this by 1/18, infra can implement a temporary routing rule, but we need explicit signoff for manual intervention in the control plane.

I attached a short timeline PDF for the proposed carveout.

—Priyom
Infra Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_rate_bridge_timeline.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Chan <nora.chan@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath launch spike — temporary throughput ask

Nora — thanks for the details and the snapshot. Internal alignment below:

- We can offer a 72-hour temporary rate bridge scoped to BrightPath's project id for the kickoff window (1/18 00:00 UTC -> 1/21 00:00 UTC).
- Infra will pre-warm additional capacity and owns the rollback gates (latency p95, GPU error spikes).
- Product will implement a TTL-based entitlement toggle (manual UI toggle for this instance) and will document the operation in the Console runbook.
- Commercials: Marissa suggests we bill the uplift at list rate and either bill normally or provide a small service credit if Redwood fails to meet the health gates. Marissa will send proposed credits language separately.

Action items:
- Rishi: confirm launch windows and provide final traffic CSV from the BrightPath engineering team (Nora) by EOD Sunday (1/16).
- Priyom: stand up manual carveout and dashboard; be on-call 1/18 00:00–1/19 08:00 PT.
- Marissa: draft short uplift agreement and credit clause.
- Kimberly/David: validate audit/log retention remains unchanged and confirm no compliance blockers.

Nora — can you confirm the final kickoff timezone and provide the token-time histogram (15m buckets) so we can size pre-warm precisely? Once we receive the CSV I'll confirm the entitlement window and send the formal uplift plan.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Success (Launch & Growth)
Redwood Inference
